orientation: outside half: rotation 0, outward is UP: nozzles point up into space; the exhaust glow overhangs above the frame (see glow.offset); the bottom 4px are the flange onto the outer wall face
notes: Concord Mk2, a hull mount (outward is up): Mk1 plus an amber collar ring on each bell and each wall collar, and a wider hatch with two lit turbines, registry stencil. Damaged: the left bell lip is dented in and hanging, the right bell cracked and sputtering, the second turbine stalled and cracked, sparks at the hatch and coupling, lamps red. Disabled: the left nozzle snapped off at the neck, the right bent over, wall collar cracked, both turbines dead, repair hatch popped. THIS FILE: the OUTSIDE half (nozzles, in space against the outer wall face; its bottom 4px are the flange onto the wall). It is never destroyed, only disabled (bent, dead, fixable).
